questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Amplitudes proportional√I: A,2A। max intensity 9I, minI। ratio 9; intensities সরাসরি add নয়।

questions.question_bn: Youngexperimentλ0.5μm,slabt=7μm,μ1.5insertedbeforeoneslit। fringeshift কত fringewidth?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Extraopticalpath(μ−1)t=0.5×(7)μm। shiftfringecountΔ/λ=(0.5×(7))/0.5=(7); orderofgeometrydoesnotaffectcount।

questions.question_bn: Young β=4mm। central bright থেকে third dark-এর distance কত mm?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Dark positions (m+½)β; first m=0, third m=2⇒(5/2)β=2.5×(4) mm।

questions.question_bn: Thickness 4μm slab index 1.5 একটি Young slit সামনে। added optical path কত μm?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Slab replaces same air distance। excess path (μ−1)t=(1.5−1)(4)=(4)/2, μt নয়।

questions.question_bn: Initially unpolarised intensity 20 W/m²। ideal polariser পরে analyser at60°। final intensity কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। প্রথম polariser unpolarised intensity অর্ধেক করে (10)। Malus at60° gives (10) cos²60°=(10)/4।

questions.question_bn: Two equal coherent sources each intensity 5। phase difference 90°। resultant intensity কত?
